reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs support the conclusion: § 14.16-type language ('Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others') is a non-exclusivity/freedom-of-action provision, and § 4.1 Charges merely points to Service Option Attachments and Order Forms — neither imposes any pricing-parity or match-third-party-offer obligation on Customer.
Rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs, so no unwarranted edit was made; deterministic checks are empty, consistent with a no-edit compliant finding.

The rationale correctly notes that the absence of an IBM-granted MFN in our favour is a commercial upside item rather than a deviation under this direction rule, which per the rule only triggers when Customer bears the MFN burden.
